text:
Sam K.: Heads-up: Prospect 'EuroBankX' asked for a POC with strict German-only processing. They want: full subprocessors list for eu-central-1, certificate chains for any third parties, and an example routing policy showing hard pinning + failover rules. Also want a rough delta on cost if we force region isolation for a 2-week POC (100k tokens/day).

Priya L.: We can run a hosted POC pinned to eu-central-1 using the tenant-pin feature but note hosted pin still uses our control plane for orchestration. For absolute separation they need Dedicated or Private.

Omar T.: Subprocessors: AWS (eu-central-1), LogKeep Inc. (logging), MetricsHub (observability). I can produce a sanitized CSV extract of subprocessors + contactable cert chains.

Sam K.: Can you include whether any subprocessors have cross-region backups? Legal specifically asked about backups being replicated outside Germany.

Omar T.: LogKeep has optional backup replication to eu-west-1 by default, but can disable for enterprise customers. AWS snapshots can be region-restricted. I'll annotate per vendor.

Priya L.: Routing policy snippet to show them (paste into SOW):
```json
{"routing_policy":"strict","region":"eu-central-1","failover":"manual","allowed_subprocessors":["aws:eu-central-1","logkeep:eu-central-1"],"audit_logs":"kept-in-region"}
```

Sam K.: Nice. Pricing delta: hosted pinned = normal usage + regional isolation fee. Dedicated small reserved = monthly reserved + setup. Can someone ballpark numbers for 100k tokens/day POC?

Omar T.: Ballpark: hosted pin premium ~ $1,000/mo + $0.02 per 1k tokens (same as hosted). Dedicated small (1x A10G equivalent) reserve ~ $6k/mo + usage. If they need guaranteed no-control-plane-exfiltration (Private), add onboarding + infra ~ $15k one-time.

security-bot: Reminder: include KMS options. Hosted supports CMKs via our enterprise KMS integration; Private uses customer-managed KMS/HSM. Add to SOW.

Sam K.: Also need to clarify control-plane metadata visibility (usage metrics vs payload). Priya, can you add a sentence we can use: we don't persist request payloads outside the pinned region; control-plane telemetry (sampling, metrics) may be processed in our control region and we can redact PII fields.

Priya L.: Added that wording to the SOW draft and flagged an action for Legal to review PCA language for third-party cert acceptance.

ops-bot: Created secure share with sanitized_subprocessors_eurobankx.zip and uploaded cert_chain_bundle.pem. Link expires in 7 days.

Sam K.: Great. Next steps: Omar share the CSV + backup flags, Priya finalize SOW snippet, I'll schedule POC kickoff with the customer (Tues). Ticket REF-8421.

Omar T.: CSV + vendor notes uploaded to the secure share.

Sam K.: Thanks team, I'll sync with the customer and bring legal onto the call.
